sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0 - p.cost_price)) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (100 - oi.discount_pct) / 100.0) DESC, CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN nt = 10 THEN total_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(total_spent) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_spent, NTILE(10) OVER(ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC, customer_id ASC) AS nt FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer_id)

sql: WITH ord AS (SELECT customer_id, order_date, LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS prev_date FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'), gaps AS (SELECT customer_id, julianday(order_date) - julianday(prev_date) AS gap FROM ord WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN gaps g ON c.customer_id = g.customer_id WHERE g.gap = (SELECT MIN(gap) FROM gaps) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY c.customer_id
